messages:
maria.p: Quick sync — we need a concrete rollout and rollback pattern for the traffic-steering + deterministic fallback feature. Two customers (Acme, FinCo) requested region-phased rollout and per-customer opt-in. Who can sketch the runbook?

jeff.k: Proposed high level: phased regions EU -> NA -> APAC, observe 36h per region, automatic revert if latency/error SLOs breach. Also require per-customer rate caps during canary.

raj: Important: fallback order must be explicit at the variant level, not just region. Example chain: primary → quantized-8bit → low-cost-reranker → region-fallback. That way we avoid sudden jumps to different regions unless all local variants fail.

sophie: Customers want a measurable A/B comparison for quality vs cost. Suggest default weights: 75% primary, 15% quant, 9% reranker, 1% holdout for baseline telemetry. Also add a 0.2% isolated holdout for long-term regressions.

alex.t: Ops guardrails: autoscale safety threshold (queue depth, avg service time). If avg queueing latency > 200ms OR p95 compute latency spikes > 2x baseline, immediately halt canary splits and revert to baseline routing in that region. Also enforce max_qps_per_customer during canary.

lisa-cs: CS asks: Rollback SLA for enterprise customers — they expect final fallback or scoped rollback within 30 minutes for FinCo. Also they require explicit customer opt-in toggle in the Console.

jeff.k: Draft staged rollout (more conservative than previous threads):
- Stage 0: Internal shadow for 24h with synthetic traffic and chaos test (no customer traffic)
- Stage 1: EU micro-canary 0.5% for 12h (basic gates)
- Stage 2: EU small canary 3% for 24h (full gating: perf, errors, cost)
- Stage 3: EU regional wide 15% for 48h with per-customer slices
- Stage 4: Ramp to steady-state region or move to NA start
Gates to fail a stage: p95_latency > 1.4x baseline OR absolute error_rate_delta > 0.4% OR inference_cost_delta > +15%

maria.p: Need a minimal feature-flag schema we can commit to the config repo and reference in the runbook — keys for region, buckets/weights, fallback_chain, gating thresholds, customer_opt_in, and quotas.

raj: Minimal flag example (ops/devex friendly):
```json
{
  "flag": "steering_v3",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "buckets": [
    {"variant": "primary", "weight": 75},
    {"variant": "quant-8bit", "weight": 15},
    {"variant": "lowcost-rerank", "weight": 9},
    {"variant": "holdout", "weight": 1}
  ],
  "fallback_chain": ["quant-8bit","lowcost-rerank","region_fallback"],
  "gates": {"p95_latency_ms": 1100, "error_rate_abs_pct": 0.4, "cost_pct_change": 15},
  "customer_opt_in": true,
  "max_qps_per_customer": 50,
  "autoscale_buffer_secs": 90,
  "eval_set_id": "rollout_quality_v3"
}
```

sophie: Add `eval_set_id` so Product/QA can wire automated A/B prompts and quality checks. Also include `sticky_session: true|false` if we need session affinity for rerankers.

alex.t: Include `throttle_on_queue_ms` and `slo_failure_action` (options: pause_canary, rollback_region, route_to_dedicated) so pipeline can act automatically.

lisa-cs: Telemetry: CS wants a per-customer dashboard tile showing latency P50/P95, error rate, cost delta, and a quality signal (semantic similarity or BLEU on eval prompts). We should expose the opt-in state and recent rollback events per account.

maria.p: Owners: eng-sre -> alerts and onboard thresholds; eng-platform -> rollout automation and flag schema; devex -> docs and sample flag; customer-success -> opt-in flow docs.

jeff.k: Launch criteria checklist (all required):
- Internal shadow + chaos completed with zero gating failures
- Canary alerting wired to pager and Console tiles
- Console opt-in toggle implemented and audited
- Runbook with rollback steps and Dedicated fallback paths
- QA A/B evaluation automated and pass quality baselines
- Legal sign-off for customers with PII routing constraints

raj: Rollback playbook (short):
1) Flip feature flag to baseline routing (100% primary) for affected region
2) Clear KV caches and drop sticky routing tokens if applicable
3) If immediate rollback doesn't restore health, route enterprise customers to Dedicated pool or region-fallback pool
4) Open incident, collect traces + evaluate, postmortem within 72h

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Applied canary config to eu-west-1 at 1999001500. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/traffic-steering (link for on-call).

maria.p: Proposed timeline: start internal shadow next Wed, EU micro-canary Fri, full EU window Mon after micro-canary. Decision review scheduled end-of-week. Any blockers?

lisa-cs: Legal needs FinCo PII routing approval. Blocker until COB Thu.

qa-team: QA will add rollout eval prompts and automated regression checks to the pipeline. ETA: Fri EOD. Tagging @devex for sample datasets.

alex.t: I'll add enforcement for max_qps_per_customer and queue-based throttle to the deployment. @eng-sre please review the autoscale thresholds.

jeff.k: If no objections, I'll land the feature-flag schema into config repo and create the Alert config PR today.

maria.p: Great, thanks everyone. I'll publish the formal rollout doc and ping stakeholders when it's ready. :rocket:
